title: Tiny, cute toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='topFace' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF8A7A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F0604F'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='frontFace' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#E2483A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C43028'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sideFace' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#A8241D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8A1A15'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow/ground hint omitted, no background -->

  <!-- block body: isometric toy block -->
  <!-- top face -->
  <polygon points='50,18 82,34 50,50 18,34' fill='url(#topFace)'/>

  <!-- front-left face -->
  <polygon points='18,34 50,50 50,82 18,66' fill='url(#frontFace)'/>

  <!-- front-right face -->
  <polygon points='50,50 82,34 82,66 50,82' fill='url(#sideFace)'/>

  <!-- top studs (round pegs) -->
  <!-- stud 1 (left) -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='29' rx='7' ry='3.8' fill='#FFB3A6'/>
  <rect x='27' y='25' width='14' height='4' fill='#FFA091'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='25' rx='7' ry='3.8' fill='#FFD0C8'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='25' rx='4.2' ry='2.2' fill='#FFE6E0'/>

  <!-- stud 2 (center) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='7' ry='3.8' fill='#FFB3A6'/>
  <rect x='43' y='18' width='14' height='4' fill='#FFA091'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='7' ry='3.8' fill='#FFD0C8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='4.2' ry='2.2' fill='#FFE6E0'/>

  <!-- stud 3 (right) -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='29' rx='7' ry='3.8' fill='#FFB3A6'/>
  <rect x='59' y='25' width='14' height='4' fill='#FFA091'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='25' rx='7' ry='3.8' fill='#FFD0C8'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='25' rx='4.2' ry='2.2' fill='#FFE6E0'/>

  <!-- cute letter 'A' on front-left face -->
  <polygon points='34,44 42,62 37,62 35.5,58 30.5,58 29,62 24,62' fill='#FFE07A'/>
  <polygon points='32,54 34,54 33,51' fill='#C43028'/>

  <!-- cute face on front-right face: two glowing eyes and a smile -->
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='58' rx='2.6' ry='3.2' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='58' rx='2.6' ry='3.2' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <path d='M60,65 Q66,70 72,65' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
